source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
completion:
3. Identify the regulatory limits for each pollutant.

   - Retrieve and list the regulatory standards for each pollutant including criteria pollutants like PM2.5, PM10, NOx, SOx, CO, Ozone, VOCs, and any other relevant pollutants for the area in question based on local, state, federal and international guidelines.

4. Collect real-time data.

   - Obtain real-time data from monitoring stations (if available) using approved methodologies and equipment. Gather data from continuous emission monitoring systems (CEMS) if installed at the industrial site.

5. Compare emissions data to regulatory limits.

   - Compare each pollutant's average concentration, peak readings, and other relevant data with the respective regulatory limits to identify any exceedances.

6. Document emission monitoring results comprehensively.

   - Record all monitoring device information, including device ID, calibration status, date and time of measurement, and personnel conducting the monitoring.
   - Log all raw
